QuestInfo.name: [NLC] A Historian's Studies
QuestInfo.0: It seems Corine still needs some time to compose herself. Speak with her and see if she's all right.
QuestInfo.1: Corine says Elpam has finished his analysis of the flora samples you brought and asks you to check in with him to see if he could use more help.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Elpam for the first time in what felt like a while.

npc.0: Elpam said he'd finished researching the flora you'd collected for him before. Could you stop by and see if he needs help with anything else?
